items.source: BeanDefinitionParser that parses a cors element in order to set the CORS configuration in the various {AbstractHandlerMapping} beans created by AnnotationDrivenBeanDefinitionParser, ResourcesBeanDefinitionParser and ViewControllerBeanDefinitionParser.
items.translation: 解析 `cors` 元素的BeanDefinitionParser，以便在由AnnotationDrivenBeanDefinitionParser、ResourcesBeanDefinitionParser 和 ViewControllerBeanDefinitionParser 创建的各个 {AbstractHandlerMapping} Bean 中设置 CORS 配置。

items.source: Abstract BeanDefinitionParser implementation providing a number of convenience methods and a template method that subclasses must override to provide the actual parsing logic.
items.translation: 抽象的 BeanDefinitionParser 实现，提供若干便捷方法以及一个子类必须重写以提供实际解析逻辑的模板方法。

items.source: Parses the view-resolvers MVC namespace element and registers ViewResolver bean definitions.
items.translation: 解析 `view-resolvers` MVC 命名空间元素，并注册`ViewResolver` Bean 定义。

items.source: Subclasses can call this to register the supplied BeanDefinitionParser to handle the specified element.
items.translation: 子类可以调用此方法来注册提供的BeanDefinitionParser以处理指定的元素。

items.source: Base class for those BeanDefinitionParser implementations that need to parse and define just a single BeanDefinition.

items.source: Convenient base class for when there exists a one-to-one mapping between attribute names on the element that is to be parsed and the property names on the Class being configured.
items.translation: 适用于元素属性名称与被配置的 Class 属性名称之间存在一对一映射情况时的便捷基类。

items.source: Parse the <mvc:freemarker-configurer> MVC namespace element and register FreeMarkerConfigurer bean.
items.translation: 解析 `<mvc:freemarker-configurer>` MVC 命名空间元素并注册 `FreeMarkerConfigurer` Bean。

items.translation: 解析 `<mvc:groovy-configurer>` MVC 命名空间元素并注册一个 `GroovyConfigurer` Bean。

items.source: Contains an abstract XML-based BeanFactory implementation, including a standard "spring-beans" XSD.
items.translation: 包含一个抽象的基于 XML 的 `BeanFactory` 实现，包括标准的"spring-beans"XSD。

items.source: Parser for the <context:component-scan/> element.
items.translation: <context:component-scan/> 元素的解析器。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

Support package for declarative scheduling configuration,
with XML schema being the primary configuration format.
